For ours the share of records is not computed: the context holds facts and fragments, not records.
The number of records is counted from the write operations in the trace at the moment the Worker reads.

Step 1 of 6
Session 1: the context is small in all systems. ours is empty: facts are extracted
only at the end of the session; in session 1 there are none yet.
Step 2 of 6
Session 5: ours 369 tokens, the others from 987 to 1332.
Until the limit is reached, the three baseline systems put all records into the context (100%).
Step 3 of 6
Session 9: shared_rag_bm25 hit the limit (2000), sliding_window nearly (1988),
full_history has no limit: 2435 tokens. ours: 600.
Step 4 of 6
Session 20: sliding_window gives 35% of records, shared_rag_bm25 31%,
full_history 5139 tokens, ours 1221 tokens, context items 84.
Step 5 of 6
Session 30: ours 1621 tokens, limit not reached. Record shares: sliding_window
23%, shared_rag_bm25 12%. full_history 7484 tokens, all records.
Step 6 of 6
This is one scenario, C6-eval-0002, not an evaluation. The numbers come from the traces of one run,
completeness of records in the context is not the same as answer correctness.
